A shopper capability lives at most SHOPPER_MAX_AGE (24 h, src/identity/sessionCapability.ts:14), the shopper object admits only grants it stored (ShopperReflex.assertGrant), and requireShopper dispatches every shopper route through that object on BOTH hosts, so a re-minted capability answers 401 on the public path (measured). The host leg therefore measures the furthest return the public route admits (the next day, inside the capability's own life) on both hosts, and the host-internal leg measures the ruled day-7 and day-14 return through serveContentDecisions inside a real owner invocation on the session host. When C6 lands, the day-7 and day-14 legs move to the public route.
